activate.description: Bring Pages to the foreground without selecting or editing a document.

activate-direct.description: Foreground Pages without opening a document.

prohibited: creating, editing, exporting, printing, sharing, or deleting a document
creating, accepting, changing, or revoking collaboration
claiming receipt, import, or exact opening from callback or launch acceptance
safety.uncertain_outcome: A launch or transfer may already have occurred. Inspect and do not replay.

data_access: No document contents, recents, collaboration, or account state is read
data_sent: One explicit user-selected local document file through AirDrop when requested
privacy.retention: No file content, path, screenshot, device identifier, or raw response is committed.
privacy.notes: Opaque collaboration identifiers are never synthesized.
